keywords: nginx warn conflicting server name ignored

upstream_sent_too_big_header.title: Nginx Upstream Sent Too Big Header
upstream_sent_too_big_header.description: The error-log line 'upstream sent too big header while reading response header from upstream' — the backend's response headers overflowed nginx's buffer. Visitors see a 502.

permission_denied_while_connecting_to_up.title: Nginx Permission Denied While Connecting to Upstream
permission_denied_while_connecting_to_up.description: The error-log line 'connect() to ... failed (13: Permission denied) while connecting to upstream' — the OS blocked nginx's connection to the backend, classically SELinux.
keywords: nginx permission denied while connecting to upstream

ah00558_could_not_reliably_determine_fqd.title: Apache AH00558 — Could Not Reliably Determine FQDN
ah00558_could_not_reliably_determine_fqd.description: The startup message 'AH00558: apache2: Could not reliably determine the server's fully qualified domain name' — Apache has no ServerName and is guessing.
keywords: could not reliably determine the server's fully qualified domain name

ah00072_could_not_bind_to_address.title: Apache AH00072 — make_sock: Could Not Bind to Address
ah00072_could_not_bind_to_address.description: The startup failure '(98)Address already in use: AH00072: make_sock: could not bind to address [::]:80' — another process holds Apache's port, or Apache is fighting itself.
keywords: make_sock could not bind to address

invalid_command_rewriteengine.title: Apache Invalid Command 'RewriteEngine'
invalid_command_rewriteengine.description: The error "Invalid command 'RewriteEngine', perhaps misspelled or defined by a module not included in the server configuration" — mod_rewrite (or another module) is not enabled.
keywords: perhaps misspelled or defined by a module not included

ah01630_client_denied_by_server_configur.title: Apache AH01630 — Client Denied by Server Configuration
ah01630_client_denied_by_server_configur.description: The error-log line 'AH01630: client denied by server configuration' — an authorization rule (usually Require directives) rejected the request. Visitors see 403 Forbidden.

ah00035_access_denied_search_permissions.title: Apache AH00035 — Search Permissions Missing on a Component of the Path
ah00035_access_denied_search_permissions.description: The error-log line 'AH00035: access to / denied ... because search permissions are missing on a component of the path' — the Apache user cannot traverse a directory above the docroot.
keywords: search permissions are missing on a component of the path

ah00161_maxrequestworkers_reached.title: Apache AH00161 — MaxRequestWorkers Reached
ah00161_maxrequestworkers_reached.description: The warning 'AH00161: server reached MaxRequestWorkers setting, consider raising the MaxRequestWorkers setting' — Apache is out of workers and queueing or refusing requests.

primary_script_unknown_php_fpm.title: Apache AH01071 — Got Error 'Primary Script Unknown' (PHP-FPM)
primary_script_unknown_php_fpm.description: The error-log line 'AH01071: Got error \'Primary script unknown\'' — Apache proxied a request to PHP-FPM, which could not find the script. Browsers show 'File not found.'
keywords: got error primary script unknown apache

ah02565_certificate_key_mismatch.title: Apache AH02565 — Certificate and Private Key Do Not Match
ah02565_certificate_key_mismatch.description: The startup failure 'AH02565: Certificate and private key ... from ... and ... do not match' — SSLCertificateFile and SSLCertificateKeyFile are not a pair.
keywords: certificate and private key do not match apache

ah00898_error_reading_from_remote_server.title: Apache AH00898 — Error Reading from Remote Server (mod_proxy)
ah00898_error_reading_from_remote_server.description: The error-log line 'AH00898: Error reading from remote server' (with AH01102 'error reading status line') — Apache's reverse proxy lost the backend mid-request. Visitors see 502.
keywords: error reading from remote server apache

ah00023_no_space_left_on_device.title: Apache AH00023 — No Space Left on Device (Mutex/Semaphore)
ah00023_no_space_left_on_device.description: The startup failure 'No space left on device: AH00023: Couldn't create the mpm-accept mutex' — usually exhausted semaphores, not an actually full disk.
keywords: no space left on device apache mutex

ah00526_syntax_error.title: Apache AH00526 — Syntax Error in Configuration
ah00526_syntax_error.description: The configtest/startup failure 'AH00526: Syntax error on line N of file' — Apache cannot parse the configuration and refuses to start or reload until it is fixed.

threaded_mpm_php_not_threadsafe.title: Apache Threaded MPM vs PHP Module Conflict
threaded_mpm_php_not_threadsafe.description: The error 'Apache is running a threaded MPM, but your PHP Module is not compiled to be threadsafe. You need to recompile PHP.' — mod_php demands the prefork MPM.
keywords: apache is running a threaded mpm but your php module is not compiled to be threadsafe

ah01276_cannot_serve_directory.title: Apache AH01276 — Cannot Serve Directory
ah01276_cannot_serve_directory.description: The error-log line 'AH01276: Cannot serve directory ...: No matching DirectoryIndex ... found, and server-generated directory index forbidden by Options directive' — visitors see 403.
keywords: directory index forbidden by options directive

cannot_find_module.title: Node.js Cannot Find Module
cannot_find_module.description: The crash "Error: Cannot find module 'x'" (code MODULE_NOT_FOUND) — Node's resolver could not locate a package or file your code requires or imports.

cannot_use_import_statement_outside_a_mo.title: Cannot Use Import Statement Outside a Module
cannot_use_import_statement_outside_a_mo.description: The crash "SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module" — ES-module syntax ran in a CommonJS context, in Node, Jest, or a browser script tag.
keywords: cannot use import statement outside a module

err_require_esm.title: Node.js ERR_REQUIRE_ESM
err_require_esm.description: The crash 'Error [ERR_REQUIRE_ESM]: require() of ES Module ... not supported' — CommonJS code tried to require() a package that ships only as an ES module.
keywords: require() of es module not supported

javascript_heap_out_of_memory.title: JavaScript Heap Out of Memory
javascript_heap_out_of_memory.description: The crash 'FATAL ERROR: Reached heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory' — the Node process hit V8's heap ceiling and aborted.

eaddrinuse_address_already_in_use.title: Node.js EADDRINUSE — Address Already in Use
eaddrinuse_address_already_in_use.description: The crash 'Error: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use :::3000' — another process (often a previous instance of the same app) already listens on the port.
keywords: listen eaddrinuse address already in use 3000

digital_envelope_routines_unsupported.title: Node.js error:0308010C — Digital Envelope Routines Unsupported
digital_envelope_routines_unsupported.description: The build crash 'Error: error:0308010C:digital envelope routines::unsupported' — Node 17+ (OpenSSL 3) rejects legacy hash usage in older webpack toolchains.

node_gyp_build_failed.title: node-gyp Build Failed
node_gyp_build_failed.description: Install failures full of 'gyp ERR! build error' and 'gyp ERR! stack' — a package with native C/C++ code could not compile on your machine.

unhandled_promise_rejection.title: Node.js Unhandled Promise Rejection
unhandled_promise_rejection.description: The crash 'Error [ERR_UNHANDLED_REJECTION]: This error originated either by throwing inside of an async function without a catch block...' — a rejected promise had no handler, and Node 15+ exits.

npm_err_elifecycle.title: npm ERR! code ELIFECYCLE
npm_err_elifecycle.description: The npm failure 'npm ERR! code ELIFECYCLE, npm ERR! errno 1' — the package.json script npm ran exited with a non-zero code. npm is the messenger, not the culprit.

npm_enoent_package_json.title: npm ERR! ENOENT — Could Not Read package.json
npm_enoent_package_json.description: The failure 'npm ERR! code ENOENT ... Could not read package.json' — npm ran in a directory that has no package.json to read.
keywords: enoent no such file or directory open package.json

unable_to_get_issuer_cert_locally.title: Node.js UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT_LOCALLY
unable_to_get_issuer_cert_locally.description: TLS failures like 'npm ERR! UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT_LOCALLY' or fetch failing with 'unable to get local issuer certificate' — Node cannot verify the server's certificate chain, typically behind a corporate proxy.
keywords: unable to get local issuer certificate
self signed certificate in certificate chain

maximum_call_stack_size_exceeded.title: Maximum Call Stack Size Exceeded
maximum_call_stack_size_exceeded.description: The crash 'RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded' — function calls nested deeper than the stack allows, almost always runaway recursion.

externally_managed_environment.title: Python error: externally-managed-environment
externally_managed_environment.description: The pip refusal 'error: externally-managed-environment' — the system Python (Debian 12+, Ubuntu 23.04+, Fedora 38+, Homebrew) blocks pip installs outside a virtual environment.

attempted_relative_import.title: Python ImportError: Attempted Relative Import
attempted_relative_import.description: The crash 'ImportError: attempted relative import with no known parent package' — relative imports only work inside a package, and this file was run as a plain script.
keywords: attempted relative import with no known parent package

command_python_not_found.title: python: command not found
command_python_not_found.description: Shell errors 'python: command not found' or Windows opening the Microsoft Store — the python command is missing from PATH, or only python3 exists.
keywords: python was not found run without arguments

unicodedecodeerror.title: Python UnicodeDecodeError
unicodedecodeerror.description: The crash "UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x.. in position .." — bytes were decoded with the wrong encoding, or binary data was opened as text.

attributeerror_nonetype.title: AttributeError: 'NoneType' Object Has No Attribute
attributeerror_nonetype.description: The most common Python traceback — a variable is None where code expected a real object, usually because some earlier call returned None.

maximum_recursion_depth.title: Python RecursionError: Maximum Recursion Depth Exceeded
maximum_recursion_depth.description: The crash 'RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded' — function calls nested past Python's limit (default 1000), almost always runaway recursion.

indentationerror.title: Python IndentationError
indentationerror.description: Crashes like 'IndentationError: unexpected indent', 'expected an indented block', and 'unindent does not match any outer indentation level' — whitespace that Python cannot parse as structure.
keywords: unindent does not match any outer indentation level

pip_ssl_module_not_available.title: pip: TLS/SSL Module Not Available
pip_ssl_module_not_available.description: The failure 'pip is configured with locations that require TLS/SSL, however the ssl module in Python is not available' — this Python was built without OpenSSL support.
keywords: ssl module in python is not available

no_module_named_pip.title: Python: No Module Named pip
no_module_named_pip.description: The failure 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named pip' (or '/usr/bin/python3: No module named pip') — this interpreter has no pip installed at all.

microsoft_visual_c_required.title: error: Microsoft Visual C++ 14.0 or Greater Is Required
microsoft_visual_c_required.description: The pip build failure 'error: Microsoft Visual C++ 14.0 or greater is required. Get it with Microsoft C++ Build Tools' — a package needs compiling and Windows has no compiler.
keywords: microsoft visual c++ 14.0 or greater is required

venv_activate_scripts_disabled.title: venv Activate: Running Scripts Is Disabled on This System
venv_activate_scripts_disabled.description: The PowerShell failure 'Activate.ps1 cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled on this system' — Windows' execution policy blocks the venv activation script.
keywords: activate.ps1 cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled
running scripts is disabled on this system

certificate_verify_failed.title: Python SSLCertVerificationError — Certificate Verify Failed
certificate_verify_failed.description: The failure 'ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate' in requests, urllib, or pip.
keywords: unable to get local issuer certificate python

error_520.title: Cloudflare Error 520 — Web Server Returns an Unknown Error
error_520.description: Cloudflare reached the origin server, but the response was empty, malformed, or cut off — something Cloudflare could not interpret as valid HTTP.
keywords: web server returns an unknown error

error_521.title: Cloudflare Error 521 — Web Server Is Down
error_521.description: Cloudflare tried to connect to the origin server and the connection was actively refused — nothing is accepting connections on the origin's port.

error_522.title: Cloudflare Error 522 — Connection Timed Out
error_522.description: Cloudflare's attempt to open a TCP connection to the origin produced no answer at all within the timeout — packets are being dropped, or the origin is too overloaded to accept.

error_523.title: Cloudflare Error 523 — Origin Is Unreachable
error_523.description: Cloudflare has no network route to the origin at all — typically because the DNS record points at a private, wrong, or no-longer-routed IP address.

error_524.title: Cloudflare Error 524 — A Timeout Occurred
error_524.description: Cloudflare connected to the origin and delivered the request, but the origin did not complete an HTTP response within 100 seconds — long jobs and slow queries are the usual story.

error_525.title: Cloudflare Error 525 — SSL Handshake Failed
error_525.description: Cloudflare tried to establish a TLS connection to the origin (Full or Full-strict SSL mode) and the handshake failed — usually no certificate is being served on port 443.

error_526.title: Cloudflare Error 526 — Invalid SSL Certificate
error_526.description: Under Full (strict) SSL mode, the origin presented a certificate that failed validation — expired, self-signed, untrusted, or issued for a different hostname.

error_1006.title: Cloudflare Errors 1006, 1007, 1008 — Access Denied: IP Banned
error_1006.description: The page 'Access denied: the owner of this website has banned your IP address' — an IP Access Rule on the site explicitly blocks your address or range.
keywords: owner of this website has banned your ip address

error_1015.title: Cloudflare Error 1015 — You Are Being Rate Limited
error_1015.description: The request tripped a Rate Limiting rule configured by the site's owner — too many requests from your IP inside the rule's time window.

error_1016.title: Cloudflare Error 1016 — Origin DNS Error
error_1016.description: Cloudflare could not resolve the origin's address: the DNS record behind the proxy points at a hostname that does not resolve — a broken CNAME target is the classic cause.

error_1020.title: Cloudflare Error 1020 — Access Denied
error_1020.description: The request matched a firewall or WAF rule on the site — country, network, user-agent, path, or bot-score conditions the owner configured (or a managed rule).

redirect_loop.title: Cloudflare Redirect Loop (ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS)
redirect_loop.description: The browser reports ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS on a site behind Cloudflare — almost always Flexible SSL mode fighting an origin that redirects HTTP to HTTPS.
